params.name: fields
params.description: Comma-separated list of fields to include or exclude (based on value provided for include_fields) in the result. Leave empty to retrieve all fields.

params.name: include_fields
params.description: Whether specified fields are to be included (true) or excluded (false). Defaults to true.

items.docs:
Find users by email. If Auth0 is the identity provider (idP), the email address associated with a user is saved in lower case, regardless of how you initially provided it. 

For example, if you register a user as JohnSmith@example.com, Auth0 saves the user's email as johnsmith@example.com. 

Therefore, when using this endpoint, make sure that you are searching for users via email addresses using the correct case.
